title: Nutritious Dense Ethiopian Ground Beef Wrap
description: A jammy, dense, and diabetic-friendly Ethiopian dish featuring ground beef, served in a lotus leaf wrap, perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the blanched and seasoned namul to the skillet and cook until heated through.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Lay a large lotus leaf flat on a work surface and spoon about 1/4 of the beef and namul mixture onto the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make 3 more wraps.
Serve the wraps hot, with additional namul and berbere spice on the side if desired.
